thesis.whyThisStock: Normal ranked screen combines older momentum, provider valuation and support proximity; actual financials permit independent challenge.
thesis.whyNow: October18 confirmed close is near measured245-250support before October29 AGM. Weak current participation and failed priced geometry require waiting.
thesis.mispricingMechanism: Sustained operating cash and credible resolution of contested audit items might support a rerating. No quantified undervaluation is established.
thesis.bullCase: Revenue1.370bn, net profit264.709m and CFO259.236m show profitable cash-generating operations; named60.302% majority and12m shares are dated. Adjusted EPS reconciles provider data.
thesis.bearCase: Price below20/50-day means and RV20 about0.40; leverage, inventory growth and audit tax/revenue/ECL disputes complicate normalized profits. Current cost-adjusted T1 reward/risk below2.
thesis.alternativeExplanation: Lower PE can compensate for control concentration, audit uncertainty and funding costs; older momentum need not imply current accumulation or mispricing.
thesis.pricedIn: Management budget and headline profit are public; no supported consensus gap or event attribution. FiveEGP proposed distribution is only1.94% of258 before approval.
thesis.invalidation: Confirmed support failure below245 and diagnostic239.37 undermines rebound; adverse tax/collection/restatement or capital evidence can invalidate business assumptions independently.
thesis.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Independent audit/tax/control-transfer resolution and sourced forecasts, verified market action dates, later confirmed bullish zone acceptance withRV20>=1 and a priced plan meeting the unchanged cost gate.
thesis.whyBetterThanAlternative: No superiority overCPCI established. CPCI has higher observed cash/profit scale and different audit issues; both fail current geometry. Compare normalized collection quality rather than universal PE ranking.
thesis.disagreementResolution: Kreston unmodified and CAO qualified assurance coexist; management counterarguments matter but are not settled cure. Strong historical cash does not remove revenue/tax uncertainty or current timing failure.
thesis.evidenceQuality: Actual issuer-linked32p accounts and named auditor/register/reply/AGM scans inspected at relevant pages, with custody/dates and explicit cash/EPS reconciliation.
thesis.uncertainties: No supported three forward cases or current fair value; exact historical bonus market dates, complete intervening news/action clearance and real sizing inputs unavailable.
